CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: First Citizens Bank is a top 20 U.S. financial institution focused on helping consumers, businesses and entrepreneurs build lasting financial security. Headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., First Citizens combines the strength and sophistication of a large bank with the personal attention and agility of a relationship-driven partner. Built over more than 125 years, the bank offers deep industry expertise, tailored financial solutions and specialized banking capabilities delivered at scale nationwide. From startups to international corporations, and personal banking to wealth management, First Citizens supports its clients' ambitions at every stage of their financial journey. Parent company First Citizens BancShares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCNCA) is a Fortune 500 company with more than $225 billion in assets.
